package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/ast"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/bundled"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/compiler"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/contentmapper"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/core"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/diagnostics"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/locale"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/parser"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/scanner"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/sourcemap"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/spanmap"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/tsoptions"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/tspath"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/vfs/vfstest"
)

var compilerRevision = "unbound"
var bridgeAPIVersion = "unbound"

type loweredSource struct {
	Text      string `json:"text"`
	SourceMap string `json:"sourceMap"`
}

type sourceFile struct {
	Path    string         `json:"path"`
	Kind    string         `json:"kind"`
	Text    string         `json:"text"`
	Lowered *loweredSource `json:"lowered"`
}

type request struct {
	RootNames []string       `json:"rootNames"`
	Files     []sourceFile   `json:"files"`
	Options   map[string]any `json:"options"`
	Lowering  string         `json:"lowering"`
}

type span struct {
	Start  int `json:"start"`
	Length int `json:"length"`
}

type diagnostic struct {
	Code     string `json:"code"`
	Category string `json:"category"`
	Message  string `json:"message"`
	File     string `json:"file,omitempty"`
	Span     *span  `json:"span,omitempty"`
	Phase    string `json:"phase,omitempty"`
}

type artifact struct {
	Path    string `json:"path"`
	Content []byte `json:"content"`
}

type result struct {
	Diagnostics []diagnostic `json:"diagnostics"`
	Artifacts   []artifact   `json:"artifacts"`
	EmitSkipped bool         `json:"emitSkipped"`
}

type wireError struct {
	Code    string `json:"code"`
	Message string `json:"message"`
}

type envelope struct {
	APIVersion       int        `json:"apiVersion"`
	CompilerRevision string     `json:"compilerRevision"`
	Result           result     `json:"result"`
	Error            *wireError `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) == 2 && os.Args[1] == "--revision" {
		fmt.Println(compilerRevision)
		return
	}
	apiVersion, err := strconv.Atoi(bridgeAPIVersion)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "invalid embedded bridge API version")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	response := envelope{APIVersion: apiVersion, CompilerRevision: compilerRevision}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(os.Stdin)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var input request
	if err := decoder.Decode(&input); err != nil {
		response.Result.EmitSkipped = true
		response.Error = &wireError{Code: "VIBE_GO_PROTOCOL", Message: err.Error()}
	} else {
		var extra any
		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
			response.Result.EmitSkipped = true
			response.Error = &wireError{Code: "VIBE_GO_PROTOCOL", Message: "expected one JSON request value"}
		} else {
			compiled, err := compile(context.Background(), input)
			response.Result = compiled
			if err != nil {
				response.Error = &wireError{Code: "VIBE_GO_COMPILE", Message: err.Error()}
			}
		}
	}
	if response.Result.Diagnostics == nil {
		response.Result.Diagnostics = []diagnostic{}
	}
	if response.Result.Artifacts == nil {
		response.Result.Artifacts = []artifact{}
	}
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(response); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

type identityProject struct{}

func (identityProject) Refresh() error                                 { return nil }
func (identityProject) Identities() ([]string, error)                  { return []string{"vibelang-poc@1"}, nil }
func (identityProject) Identity(*contentmapper.Mapper) (string, error) { return "vibelang-poc@1", nil }
func (identityProject) WatchedFiles() ([]string, error)                { return nil, nil }
func (identityProject) Diagnostics() []contentmapper.OptionDiagnostic  { return nil }
func (identityProject) Close() error                                   { return nil }
func (identityProject) Transform(_ *contentmapper.Mapper, request contentmapper.Request) (contentmapper.Result, error) {
	segments := []spanmap.Segment(nil)
	if request.Content != "" {
		segments = []spanmap.Segment{{
			VirtualStart:  0,
			VirtualEnd:    core.TextPos(len(request.Content)),
			OriginalStart: 0,
			OriginalEnd:   core.TextPos(len(request.Content)),
			Kind:          spanmap.KindVerbatim,
			Features:      spanmap.FeatureAll,
		}}
	}
	return contentmapper.Result{
		Text:             request.Content,
		VirtualExtension: ".ts",
		Mappings:         spanmap.New(segments),
	}, nil
}

// mappingPoint is one decoded segment of an authored→lowered source map: a
// lowered (generated side) position and its optional authored origin. Columns
// are UTF-16 code units.
type mappingPoint struct {
	generatedCharacter int
	hasSource          bool
	sourceLine         int
	sourceCharacter    int
}

// vibeInput is one authored `.vibe` compiler input together with its lowered
// TypeScript. In identity mode the lowered text is the authored text and the
// points describe a line-for-line identity mapping.
type vibeInput struct {
	logicalPath   string // request path, e.g. "dir/x.vibe"
	authoredName  string // virtual authored name, e.g. "/src/dir/x.vibe"
	loweredName   string // virtual lowered name, e.g. "/src/dir/x.vibe.ts"
	authoredText  string
	loweredText   string
	authoredLines *lineIndex
	loweredLines  *lineIndex
	points        [][]mappingPoint // per lowered line, sorted by generatedCharacter
}

// project is the validated in-memory compilation unit shared by both modes.
type project struct {
	external         bool
	vibeByLogical    map[string]*vibeInput
	vibeByLowered    map[string]*vibeInput
	tsTexts          map[string]string // virtual name → text for plain TypeScript inputs
	logicalByVirtual map[string]string
	checkedFiles     map[string]string // authored names, identity checked program
	checkedRoots     []string
	emitFiles        map[string]string // lowered names, emit/external program
	emitRoots        []string
	renames          map[string]string // emitted "/out/..." path → final "/out/..." path
}

func compile(ctx context.Context, input request) (result, error) {
	if !bundled.Embedded {
		return result{EmitSkipped: true}, fmt.Errorf("the pinned compiler was built without embedded TypeScript libraries")
	}
	options, err := compilerOptions(input.Options)
	if err != nil {
		return result{EmitSkipped: true}, err
	}
	project, err := buildProject(input)
	if err != nil {
		return result{EmitSkipped: true}, err
	}
	if project.external {
		return compileExternal(ctx, options, project)
	}
	return compileIdentity(ctx, options, project)
}

func buildProject(input request) (*project, error) {
	external := false
	switch input.Lowering {
	case "":
	case "external":
		external = true
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported lowering mode %q", input.Lowering)
	}

	built := &project{
		external:         external,
		vibeByLogical:    make(map[string]*vibeInput),
		vibeByLowered:    make(map[string]*vibeInput),
		tsTexts:          make(map[string]string),
		logicalByVirtual: make(map[string]string),
		checkedFiles:     make(map[string]string),
		emitFiles:        make(map[string]string),
		renames:          make(map[string]string),
	}
	claim := func(virtualName string, logicalPath string) error {
		if _, exists := built.logicalByVirtual[virtualName]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("duplicate compiler input %q", logicalPath)
		}
		built.logicalByVirtual[virtualName] = logicalPath
		return nil
	}
	for _, file := range input.Files {
		authoredName, err := virtualFileName(file.Path)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		isVibe := strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(file.Path), ".vibe")
		switch file.Kind {
		case "vibe":
			if !isVibe {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %q has kind %q but not a .vibe extension", file.Path, file.Kind)
			}
		case "typescript":
			if isVibe {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %q has a .vibe extension but kind %q", file.Path, file.Kind)
			}
		default:
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported file kind %q for %q", file.Kind, file.Path)
		}
		if !isVibe {
			if file.Lowered != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %q is not a .vibe file and must not carry lowered content", file.Path)
			}
			if err := claim(authoredName, file.Path); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			built.tsTexts[authoredName] = file.Text
			built.checkedFiles[authoredName] = file.Text
			built.emitFiles[authoredName] = file.Text
			continue
		}

		vibe := &vibeInput{
			logicalPath:   file.Path,
			authoredName:  authoredName,
			loweredName:   authoredName + ".ts",
			authoredText:  file.Text,
			authoredLines: newLineIndex(file.Text),
		}
		if external {
			if file.Lowered == nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("external lowering requires lowered content for .vibe file %q", file.Path)
			}
			if file.Lowered.Text == "" {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("lowered text for %q is empty", file.Path)
			}
			vibe.loweredText = file.Lowered.Text
			vibe.loweredLines = newLineIndex(vibe.loweredText)
			if err := decodeSuppliedMap(vibe, file.Lowered.SourceMap); err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("lowered source map for %q: %w", file.Path, err)
			}
		} else {
			if file.Lowered != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %q carries lowered content but the request does not use \"external\" lowering", file.Path)
			}
			vibe.loweredText = file.Text
			vibe.loweredLines = vibe.authoredLines
			vibe.points = identityPoints(vibe.authoredLines)
		}
		if err := claim(authoredName, file.Path); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if err := claim(vibe.loweredName, file.Path); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		built.vibeByLogical[file.Path] = vibe
		built.vibeByLowered[vibe.loweredName] = vibe
		built.checkedFiles[authoredName] = file.Text
		built.emitFiles[vibe.loweredName] = vibe.loweredText

		trimmed := file.Path[:len(file.Path)-len(".vibe")]
		built.renames["/out/"+trimmed+".vibe.js"] = "/out/" + trimmed + ".js"
		built.renames["/out/"+trimmed+".vibe.js.map"] = "/out/" + trimmed + ".js.map"
		built.renames["/out/"+trimmed+".vibe.d.ts"] = "/out/" + trimmed + ".d.vibe.ts"
		built.renames["/out/"+trimmed+".vibe.d.ts.map"] = "/out/" + trimmed + ".d.vibe.ts.map"
	}

	for _, rootName := range input.RootNames {
		authoredName, err := virtualFileName(rootName)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		logical, exists := built.logicalByVirtual[authoredName]
		if !exists || logical != rootName {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("root %q is absent from files", rootName)
		}
		built.checkedRoots = append(built.checkedRoots, authoredName)
		if vibe, ok := built.vibeByLogical[rootName]; ok {
			built.emitRoots = append(built.emitRoots, vibe.loweredName)
		} else {
			built.emitRoots = append(built.emitRoots, authoredName)
		}
	}
	return built, nil
}

func identityPoints(lines *lineIndex) [][]mappingPoint {
	points := make([][]mappingPoint, lines.lineCount())
	for line := range points {
		points[line] = []mappingPoint{{generatedCharacter: 0, hasSource: true, sourceLine: line, sourceCharacter: 0}}
	}
	return points
}

// suppliedSourceMap is the exact accepted field set for an authored→lowered
// version-3 source map. Unknown fields are rejected.
type suppliedSourceMap struct {
	Version        int       `json:"version"`
	File           string    `json:"file"`
	SourceRoot     string    `json:"sourceRoot"`
	Sources        []string  `json:"sources"`
	SourcesContent []*string `json:"sourcesContent"`
	Names          []string  `json:"names"`
	Mappings       *string   `json:"mappings"`
}

// decodeSuppliedMap validates an externally supplied authored→lowered source
// map against the authored and lowered texts and stores its mapping points.
func decodeSuppliedMap(vibe *vibeInput, mapText string) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(mapText))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var parsed suppliedSourceMap
	if err := decoder.Decode(&parsed); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("parse: %w", err)
	}
	var extra any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return errors.New("parse: expected one JSON value")
	}
	if parsed.Version != 3 {
		return fmt.Errorf("version must be 3, got %d", parsed.Version)
	}
	if parsed.SourceRoot != "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("sourceRoot must be empty, got %q", parsed.SourceRoot)
	}
	if len(parsed.Sources) != 1 {
		return fmt.Errorf("sources must name exactly the authored file, got %d entries", len(parsed.Sources))
	}
	if cleaned := path.Clean(parsed.Sources[0]); cleaned != path.Clean(vibe.logicalPath) {
		return fmt.Errorf("sources must name the authored file %q, got %q", vibe.logicalPath, parsed.Sources[0])
	}
	if parsed.SourcesContent != nil {
		if len(parsed.SourcesContent) != 1 || parsed.SourcesContent[0] == nil {
			return errors.New("sourcesContent must be exactly the authored text")
		}
		if *parsed.SourcesContent[0] != vibe.authoredText {
			return errors.New("sourcesContent does not match the supplied authored text")
		}
	}
	if parsed.Mappings == nil {
		return errors.New("mappings is required")
	}

	points := make([][]mappingPoint, vibe.loweredLines.lineCount())
	mappings := sourcemap.DecodeMappings(*parsed.Mappings)
	for mapping := range mappings.Values() {
		if mapping.GeneratedLine >= vibe.loweredLines.lineCount() {
			return fmt.Errorf("mapping targets lowered line %d beyond the lowered text", mapping.GeneratedLine)
		}
		if int(mapping.GeneratedCharacter) > vibe.loweredLines.utf16Length(mapping.GeneratedLine) {
			return fmt.Errorf("mapping targets lowered column %d beyond lowered line %d", mapping.GeneratedCharacter, mapping.GeneratedLine)
		}
		point := mappingPoint{generatedCharacter: int(mapping.GeneratedCharacter)}
		if mapping.IsSourceMapping() {
			if mapping.SourceIndex != 0 {
				return fmt.Errorf("mapping source index %d does not name the authored file", mapping.SourceIndex)
			}
			if mapping.SourceLine >= vibe.authoredLines.lineCount() {
				return fmt.Errorf("mapping targets authored line %d beyond the authored text", mapping.SourceLine)
			}
			if int(mapping.SourceCharacter) > vibe.authoredLines.utf16Length(mapping.SourceLine) {
				return fmt.Errorf("mapping targets authored column %d beyond authored line %d", mapping.SourceCharacter, mapping.SourceLine)
			}
			point.hasSource = true
			point.sourceLine = mapping.SourceLine
			point.sourceCharacter = int(mapping.SourceCharacter)
		} else if mapping.SourceIndex != sourcemap.MissingSource {
			return errors.New("mapping has a partial source position")
		}
		if mapping.NameIndex != sourcemap.MissingName && (mapping.NameIndex < 0 || int(mapping.NameIndex) >= len(parsed.Names)) {
			return fmt.Errorf("mapping name index %d is out of range", mapping.NameIndex)
		}
		points[mapping.GeneratedLine] = append(points[mapping.GeneratedLine], point)
	}
	if err := mappings.Error(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("mappings: %w", err)
	}
	for _, row := range points {
		sort.SliceStable(row, func(i, j int) bool { return row[i].generatedCharacter < row[j].generatedCharacter })
	}
	vibe.points = points
	return nil
}

// mapLoweredPosition maps a lowered (line, UTF-16 column) position to its
// authored counterpart: the greatest mapping on the same lowered line at or
// before the column, with the authored column advancing one-for-one within the
// mapping's run, clamped to the authored line end. Positions on lines without
// mappings, before the first mapping of their line, or inside a mapping that
// has no source are unmapped.
func mapLoweredPosition(vibe *vibeInput, line int, column int) (int, int, bool) {
	if line < 0 || line >= len(vibe.points) {
		return 0, 0, false
	}
	row := vibe.points[line]
	index := sort.Search(len(row), func(i int) bool { return row[i].generatedCharacter > column }) - 1
	if index < 0 {
		return 0, 0, false
	}
	point := row[index]
	if !point.hasSource {
		return 0, 0, false
	}
	authoredColumn := point.sourceCharacter + (column - point.generatedCharacter)
	if limit := vibe.authoredLines.utf16Length(point.sourceLine); authoredColumn > limit {
		authoredColumn = limit
	}
	return point.sourceLine, authoredColumn, true
}

// mapLoweredSpan converts a lowered byte-offset span into an authored span.
// An unmapped start yields no span; an unmapped end keeps the lowered length,
// clamped to the authored text.
func (vibe *vibeInput) mapLoweredSpan(start int, length int) *span {
	startLine, startColumn := vibe.loweredLines.position(start)
	authoredLine, authoredColumn, ok := mapLoweredPosition(vibe, startLine, startColumn)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	authoredStart := vibe.authoredLines.byteOffset(authoredLine, authoredColumn)
	endLine, endColumn := vibe.loweredLines.position(start + length)
	if mappedEndLine, mappedEndColumn, endOK := mapLoweredPosition(vibe, endLine, endColumn); endOK {
		if authoredEnd := vibe.authoredLines.byteOffset(mappedEndLine, mappedEndColumn); authoredEnd >= authoredStart {
			return &span{Start: authoredStart, Length: authoredEnd - authoredStart}
		}
	}
	if authoredStart+length > len(vibe.authoredText) {
		length = len(vibe.authoredText) - authoredStart
	}
	return &span{Start: authoredStart, Length: length}
}

func (p *project) convertDiagnostic(item *ast.Diagnostic, phase string) diagnostic {
	source := item.Source()
	if source == "" {
		source = "TS"
	}
	converted := diagnostic{
		Code:     source + strconv.FormatInt(int64(item.Code()), 10),
		Category: categoryName(item.Category()),
		Message:  item.Localize(locale.Default),
		Phase:    phase,
	}
	file := item.File()
	if file == nil {
		return converted
	}
	fileName := file.OriginalFileName()
	if vibe, ok := p.vibeByLowered[fileName]; ok {
		converted.File = vibe.logicalPath
		if item.Pos() >= 0 {
			converted.Span = vibe.mapLoweredSpan(item.Pos(), item.Len())
		}
		return converted
	}
	if logical, ok := p.logicalByVirtual[fileName]; ok {
		converted.File = logical
	} else {
		converted.File = strings.TrimPrefix(fileName, "/src/")
	}
	if item.Pos() >= 0 {
		converted.Span = &span{Start: item.Pos(), Length: item.Len()}
	}
	return converted
}

type diagnosticCollector struct {
	project   *project
	converted []diagnostic
	seen      map[string]struct{}
}

func newDiagnosticCollector(p *project) *diagnosticCollector {
	return &diagnosticCollector{project: p, converted: make([]diagnostic, 0), seen: make(map[string]struct{})}
}

func (c *diagnosticCollector) add(phase string, items []*ast.Diagnostic) {
	for _, item := range items {
		convertedItem := c.project.convertDiagnostic(item, phase)
		key := convertedItem.Code + "\x00" + convertedItem.File + "\x00" + convertedItem.Message
		if convertedItem.Span != nil {
			key += "\x00" + strconv.Itoa(convertedItem.Span.Start) + "\x00" + strconv.Itoa(convertedItem.Span.Length)
		}
		if _, exists := c.seen[key]; exists {
			continue
		}
		c.seen[key] = struct{}{}
		c.converted = append(c.converted, convertedItem)
	}
}

func (c *diagnosticCollector) collectProgram(ctx context.Context, program *compiler.Program) {
	c.add("parse", program.GetConfigFileParsingDiagnostics())
	c.add("parse", program.GetSyntacticDiagnostics(ctx, nil))
	c.add("bind", program.GetBindDiagnostics(ctx, nil))
	c.add("check", program.GetProgramDiagnostics())
	c.add("check", program.GetGlobalDiagnostics(ctx))
	c.add("check", program.GetSemanticDiagnostics(ctx, nil))
}

// compileIdentity checks authored `.vibe` files through the fork's identity
// content mapper, emits mapped declarations from that Program, and runs the
// shared runtime emit pipeline over the (identical) lowered texts.
func compileIdentity(ctx context.Context, options *core.CompilerOptions, project *project) (result, error) {
	fs := bundled.WrapFS(vfstest.FromMap(project.checkedFiles, true))
	mapper := &contentmapper.Mapper{
		Definition: contentmapper.Definition{Package: "vibelang", Extensions: []string{".vibe"}},
		Manifest:   contentmapper.Manifest{Name: "vibelang-poc", Version: "1"},
	}
	config := &tsoptions.ParsedCommandLine{ParsedConfig: &tsoptions.ParsedOptions{
		FileNames:       project.checkedRoots,
		CompilerOptions: options,
		ContentMappers:  []*contentmapper.Mapper{mapper},
	}}
	program := compiler.NewProgram(compiler.ProgramOptions{
		Config:         config,
		Host:           compiler.NewCompilerHost("/src", fs, bundled.LibPath(), nil, nil, identityProject{}),
		SingleThreaded: core.TSTrue,
	})

	collector := newDiagnosticCollector(project)
	collector.collectProgram(ctx, program)

	// Upstream deliberately delegates runtime output for content-mapped files
	// to the mapper/build tool, so this Program only owns declaration emit; the
	// shared emit pipeline below owns runtime JavaScript for all inputs.
	artifacts := make([]artifact, 0)
	if options.Declaration.IsTrue() && !options.NoEmit.IsTrue() {
		mappedEmit := program.Emit(ctx, compiler.EmitOptions{
			EmitOnly: compiler.EmitOnlyDts,
			WriteFile: func(fileName string, text string, _ *compiler.WriteFileData) error {
				artifacts = append(artifacts, artifact{Path: fileName, Content: []byte(text)})
				return nil
			},
		})
		collector.add("emit", mappedEmit.Diagnostics)
	}

	emitSkipped := true
	runEmit := !options.NoEmit.IsTrue() && (!options.NoEmitOnError.IsTrue() || !hasError(collector.converted))
	if runEmit {
		runtimeOptions := options.Clone()
		// Mapped declarations are emitted by the checked Program above. This
		// pass owns runtime JavaScript and its source map only.
		runtimeOptions.Declaration = core.TSFalse
		runtimeOptions.DeclarationMap = core.TSFalse
		runtimeOptions.EmitDeclarationOnly = core.TSFalse
		runtimeOptions.NoEmitOnError = core.TSFalse
		runtimeArtifacts, runtimeSkipped, err := runEmitProgram(ctx, runtimeOptions, project, collector, "emit")
		if err != nil {
			return result{Diagnostics: collector.converted, Artifacts: finishArtifacts(artifacts), EmitSkipped: true}, err
		}
		artifacts = append(artifacts, runtimeArtifacts...)
		emitSkipped = runtimeSkipped
	}
	finished := finishArtifacts(artifacts)
	if err := checkArtifactCollisions(finished); err != nil {
		return result{Diagnostics: collector.converted, Artifacts: []artifact{}, EmitSkipped: true}, err
	}
	return result{Diagnostics: collector.converted, Artifacts: finished, EmitSkipped: emitSkipped}, nil
}

// compileExternal checks externally lowered TypeScript through one fork
// Program, maps its diagnostics back to the authored `.vibe` positions, and
// emits declarations plus runtime JavaScript whose source maps are composed
// with the supplied authored maps.
func compileExternal(ctx context.Context, options *core.CompilerOptions, project *project) (result, error) {
	collector := newDiagnosticCollector(project)
	checkProgram := newEmitProgram(options, project)
	collector.collectProgram(ctx, checkProgram)

	emitSkipped := true
	artifacts := make([]artifact, 0)
	runEmit := !options.NoEmit.IsTrue() && (!options.NoEmitOnError.IsTrue() || !hasError(collector.converted))
	if runEmit {
		raw := make([]artifact, 0)
		emit := checkProgram.Emit(ctx, compiler.EmitOptions{WriteFile: func(fileName string, text string, _ *compiler.WriteFileData) error {
			raw = append(raw, artifact{Path: fileName, Content: []byte(text)})
			return nil
		}})
		collector.add("emit", emit.Diagnostics)
		finalized, err := finalizeEmittedArtifacts(raw, project)
		if err != nil {
			return result{Diagnostics: collector.converted, Artifacts: []artifact{}, EmitSkipped: true}, err
		}
		artifacts = finalized
		emitSkipped = emit.EmitSkipped
	}
	finished := finishArtifacts(artifacts)
	if err := checkArtifactCollisions(finished); err != nil {
		return result{Diagnostics: collector.converted, Artifacts: []artifact{}, EmitSkipped: true}, err
	}
	return result{Diagnostics: collector.converted, Artifacts: finished, EmitSkipped: emitSkipped}, nil
}

func newEmitProgram(options *core.CompilerOptions, project *project) *compiler.Program {
	fs := bundled.WrapFS(vfstest.FromMap(project.emitFiles, true))
	return compiler.NewProgram(compiler.ProgramOptions{
		Config: &tsoptions.ParsedCommandLine{ParsedConfig: &tsoptions.ParsedOptions{
			FileNames:       project.emitRoots,
			CompilerOptions: options,
		}},
		Host:           compiler.NewCompilerHost("/src", fs, bundled.LibPath(), nil, nil, nil),
		SingleThreaded: core.TSTrue,
	})
}

// runEmitProgram runs a fresh Program over the lowered file set, collecting
// its diagnostics under the given phase, and finalizes the emitted artifacts.
func runEmitProgram(ctx context.Context, options *core.CompilerOptions, project *project, collector *diagnosticCollector, phase string) ([]artifact, bool, error) {
	program := newEmitProgram(options, project)
	collector.add(phase, program.GetSyntacticDiagnostics(ctx, nil))
	collector.add(phase, program.GetSemanticDiagnostics(ctx, nil))
	raw := make([]artifact, 0)
	emit := program.Emit(ctx, compiler.EmitOptions{WriteFile: func(fileName string, text string, _ *compiler.WriteFileData) error {
		raw = append(raw, artifact{Path: fileName, Content: []byte(text)})
		return nil
	}})
	collector.add(phase, emit.Diagnostics)
	finalized, err := finalizeEmittedArtifacts(raw, project)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, true, err
	}
	return finalized, emit.EmitSkipped, nil
}

// specifierEdit is one replacement of a `.vibe` import specifier inside an
// emitted JavaScript file, in pre-edit coordinates.
type specifierEdit struct {
	byteStart   int
	byteEnd     int
	replacement string
	line        int
	utf16Start  int
	utf16OldEnd int
	utf16NewLen int
}

// finalizeEmittedArtifacts rewrites relative `.vibe` import specifiers in
// emitted JavaScript to their emitted `.js` names, renames `.vibe`-derived
// outputs to their final artifact names, and composes every emitted source map
// back to the authored `.vibe` sources.
func finalizeEmittedArtifacts(raw []artifact, project *project) ([]artifact, error) {
	editsByCodePath := make(map[string][]specifierEdit)
	for index := range raw {
		item := &raw[index]
		if strings.HasSuffix(item.Path, ".js") {
			text := string(item.Content)
			edits, err := planSpecifierEdits(project, item.Path, text)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if len(edits) != 0 {
				editsByCodePath[item.Path] = edits
				text = applySpecifierEdits(text, edits)
			}
			if finalPath, renamed := project.renames[item.Path]; renamed {
				text = rewriteSourceMapURL(text, path.Base(item.Path)+".map", path.Base(finalPath)+".map")
			}
			item.Content = []byte(text)
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasSuffix(item.Path, ".d.ts") {
			if finalPath, renamed := project.renames[item.Path]; renamed {
				text := rewriteSourceMapURL(string(item.Content), path.Base(item.Path)+".map", path.Base(finalPath)+".map")
				item.Content = []byte(text)
			}
		}
	}
	for index := range raw {
		item := &raw[index]
		if !strings.HasSuffix(item.Path, ".map") {
			continue
		}
		codePath := strings.TrimSuffix(item.Path, ".map")
		finalCodePath := codePath
		if renamed, ok := project.renames[codePath]; ok {
			finalCodePath = renamed
		}
		composed, err := composeEmittedMap(project, item.Path, string(item.Content), editsByCodePath[codePath], path.Base(finalCodePath))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("compose source map %q: %w", item.Path, err)
		}
		item.Content = []byte(composed)
	}
	finalized := make([]artifact, 0, len(raw))
	for _, item := range raw {
		finalPath := item.Path
		if renamed, ok := project.renames[item.Path]; ok {
			finalPath = renamed
		}
		finalized = append(finalized, artifact{Path: finalPath, Content: item.Content})
	}
	return finalized, nil
}

// planSpecifierEdits parses one emitted JavaScript file with the fork parser
// and plans deterministic rewrites of relative import specifiers that end in
// `.vibe` and name a project `.vibe` input.
func planSpecifierEdits(project *project, artifactPath string, text string) ([]specifierEdit, error) {
	parsed := parser.ParseSourceFile(ast.SourceFileParseOptions{
		FileName: artifactPath,
		Path:     tspath.Path(artifactPath),
	}, text, core.ScriptKindJS)
	lines := newLineIndex(text)
	edits := make([]specifierEdit, 0)
	for _, literal := range parsed.Imports() {
		specifier := literal.Text()
		if !strings.HasPrefix(specifier, "./") && !strings.HasPrefix(specifier, "../") {
			continue
		}
		if !strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(specifier), ".vibe") {
			continue
		}
		resolved := path.Clean(path.Join(path.Dir(artifactPath), specifier))
		logical := strings.TrimPrefix(resolved, "/out/")
		if _, known := project.vibeByLogical[logical]; !known {
			continue
		}
		start := scanner.SkipTrivia(text, literal.Pos())
		end := literal.End()
		if start < 0 || end > len(text) || end-start < 2 {
			continue
		}
		quoted := text[start:end]
		quote := quoted[0]
		if (quote != '"' && quote != '\'' && quote != '`') || quoted[len(quoted)-1] != quote {
			continue
		}
		if quoted[1:len(quoted)-1] != specifier {
			// The printed literal uses escapes; leave it untouched rather than
			// guess at its raw form.
			continue
		}
		replacement := string(quote) + specifier[:len(specifier)-len(".vibe")] + ".js" + string(quote)
		startLine, startColumn := lines.position(start)
		endLine, endColumn := lines.position(end)
		if startLine != endLine {
			continue
		}
		edits = append(edits, specifierEdit{
			byteStart:   start,
			byteEnd:     end,
			replacement: replacement,
			line:        startLine,
			utf16Start:  startColumn,
			utf16OldEnd: endColumn,
			utf16NewLen: utf16Extent(replacement),
		})
	}
	sort.Slice(edits, func(i, j int) bool { return edits[i].byteStart < edits[j].byteStart })
	return edits, nil
}

func applySpecifierEdits(text string, edits []specifierEdit) string {
	var builder strings.Builder
	previous := 0
	for _, edit := range edits {
		builder.WriteString(text[previous:edit.byteStart])
		builder.WriteString(edit.replacement)
		previous = edit.byteEnd
	}
	builder.WriteString(text[previous:])
	return builder.String()
}

func rewriteSourceMapURL(text string, oldName string, newName string) string {
	return strings.ReplaceAll(text, "//# sourceMappingURL="+oldName, "//# sourceMappingURL="+newName)
}

// emittedSourceMap is the exact field set the pinned fork emits for a
// version-3 source map.
type emittedSourceMap struct {
	Version        int       `json:"version"`
	File           string    `json:"file"`
	SourceRoot     string    `json:"sourceRoot"`
	Sources        []string  `json:"sources"`
	Names          []string  `json:"names"`
	Mappings       string    `json:"mappings"`
	SourcesContent []*string `json:"sourcesContent"`
}

// composeEmittedMap composes a fork-emitted source map (generated artifact →
// lowered virtual file) with each `.vibe` file's authored→lowered map so the
// final map's sources are the authored `.vibe` files. Generated positions are
// first shifted across the specifier edits applied to the emitted text.
// Emitted positions whose lowered position is unmapped in the supplied map
// stay unmapped. Name entries are deliberately dropped: the authored names are
// not known to the bridge.
func composeEmittedMap(project *project, mapPath string, mapText string, edits []specifierEdit, finalFileBase string) (string, error) {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(mapText))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var emitted emittedSourceMap
	if err := decoder.Decode(&emitted); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if emitted.Version != 3 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("emitted source map version %d is not 3", emitted.Version)
	}
	mapDirectory := path.Dir(mapPath)
	generator := sourcemap.NewGenerator(finalFileBase, "", mapDirectory, tspath.ComparePathsOptions{UseCaseSensitiveFileNames: true})
	includeContent := len(emitted.SourcesContent) != 0

	type sourceTarget struct {
		vibe  *vibeInput
		index sourcemap.SourceIndex
	}
	targets := make([]sourceTarget, len(emitted.Sources))
	for index, source := range emitted.Sources {
		resolved := path.Clean(path.Join(mapDirectory, source))
		if vibe, ok := project.vibeByLowered[resolved]; ok {
			generatorIndex := generator.AddSource(vibe.authoredName)
			if includeContent {
				if err := generator.SetSourceContent(generatorIndex, vibe.authoredText); err != nil {
					return "", err
				}
			}
			targets[index] = sourceTarget{vibe: vibe, index: generatorIndex}
			continue
		}
		generatorIndex := generator.AddSource(resolved)
		if includeContent {
			content := ""
			if text, ok := project.tsTexts[resolved]; ok {
				content = text
			} else if index < len(emitted.SourcesContent) && emitted.SourcesContent[index] != nil {
				content = *emitted.SourcesContent[index]
			}
			if err := generator.SetSourceContent(generatorIndex, content); err != nil {
				return "", err
			}
		}
		targets[index] = sourceTarget{index: generatorIndex}
	}

	editsByLine := make(map[int][]specifierEdit)
	for _, edit := range edits {
		editsByLine[edit.line] = append(editsByLine[edit.line], edit)
	}
	mappings := sourcemap.DecodeMappings(emitted.Mappings)
	for mapping := range mappings.Values() {
		generatedColumn := adjustGeneratedColumn(int(mapping.GeneratedCharacter), editsByLine[mapping.GeneratedLine])
		if !mapping.IsSourceMapping() {
			if err := generator.AddGeneratedMapping(mapping.GeneratedLine, core.UTF16Offset(generatedColumn)); err != nil {
				return "", err
			}
			continue
		}
		if int(mapping.SourceIndex) >= len(targets) {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("emitted mapping source index %d is out of range", mapping.SourceIndex)
		}
		target := targets[mapping.SourceIndex]
		if target.vibe == nil {
			if err := generator.AddSourceMapping(mapping.GeneratedLine, core.UTF16Offset(generatedColumn), target.index, mapping.SourceLine, mapping.SourceCharacter); err != nil {
				return "", err
			}
			continue
		}
		authoredLine, authoredColumn, ok := mapLoweredPosition(target.vibe, mapping.SourceLine, int(mapping.SourceCharacter))
		if !ok {
			if err := generator.AddGeneratedMapping(mapping.GeneratedLine, core.UTF16Offset(generatedColumn)); err != nil {
				return "", err
			}
			continue
		}
		if err := generator.AddSourceMapping(mapping.GeneratedLine, core.UTF16Offset(generatedColumn), target.index, authoredLine, core.UTF16Offset(authoredColumn)); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
	}
	if err := mappings.Error(); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	composed, err := json.Marshal(generator.RawSourceMap())
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return string(composed), nil
}

// adjustGeneratedColumn shifts a pre-edit UTF-16 column across the specifier
// edits applied to its line. Columns inside a replaced span clamp to the
// replacement start.
func adjustGeneratedColumn(column int, edits []specifierEdit) int {
	adjusted := column
	for _, edit := range edits {
		if column >= edit.utf16OldEnd {
			adjusted += edit.utf16NewLen - (edit.utf16OldEnd - edit.utf16Start)
			continue
		}
		if column > edit.utf16Start {
			adjusted -= column - edit.utf16Start
		}
		break
	}
	return adjusted
}

// finishArtifacts trims the virtual output prefix and orders artifacts.
func finishArtifacts(artifacts []artifact) []artifact {
	finished := make([]artifact, 0, len(artifacts))
	for _, item := range artifacts {
		finished = append(finished, artifact{Path: emittedFileName(item.Path), Content: item.Content})
	}
	sort.Slice(finished, func(i, j int) bool { return finished[i].Path < finished[j].Path })
	return finished
}

func checkArtifactCollisions(artifacts []artifact) error {
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(artifacts))
	for _, item := range artifacts {
		if _, exists := seen[item.Path]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("emitted artifact path collision at %q", item.Path)
		}
		seen[item.Path] = struct{}{}
	}
	return nil
}

func hasError(items []diagnostic) bool {
	for _, item := range items {
		if item.Category == "error" {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func compilerOptions(raw map[string]any) (*core.CompilerOptions, error) {
	options := &core.CompilerOptions{
		Target:           core.ScriptTargetES2022,
		Module:           core.ModuleKindESNext,
		ModuleResolution: core.ModuleResolutionKindBundler,
		RootDir:          "/src",
		OutDir:           "/out",
		Strict:           core.TSTrue,
		SkipLibCheck:     core.TSTrue,
		SourceMap:        core.TSTrue,
		InlineSources:    core.TSTrue,
		NoEmitOnError:    core.TSTrue,
	}
	for name, value := range raw {
		switch name {
		case "sourceMap":
			parsed, err := tristate(value)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, optionError(name, err)
			}
			options.SourceMap = parsed
		case "inlineSources":
			parsed, err := tristate(value)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, optionError(name, err)
			}
			options.InlineSources = parsed
		case "declaration":
			parsed, err := tristate(value)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, optionError(name, err)
			}
			options.Declaration = parsed
		case "declarationMap":
			parsed, err := tristate(value)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, optionError(name, err)
			}
			options.DeclarationMap = parsed
		case "noEmitOnError":
			parsed, err := tristate(value)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, optionError(name, err)
			}
			options.NoEmitOnError = parsed
		case "noEmit":
			parsed, err := tristate(value)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, optionError(name, err)
			}
			options.NoEmit = parsed
		case "strict":
			parsed, err := tristate(value)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, optionError(name, err)
			}
			options.Strict = parsed
		case "target":
			text, ok := value.(string)
			if !ok {
				return nil, optionError(name, fmt.Errorf("must be a string"))
			}
			switch strings.ToLower(text) {
			case "es2015":
				options.Target = core.ScriptTargetES2015
			case "es2020":
				options.Target = core.ScriptTargetES2020
			case "es2022":
				options.Target = core.ScriptTargetES2022
			case "esnext":
				options.Target = core.ScriptTargetESNext
			default:
				return nil, optionError(name, fmt.Errorf("unsupported value %q", text))
			}
		case "module":
			text, ok := value.(string)
			if !ok {
				return nil, optionError(name, fmt.Errorf("must be a string"))
			}
			switch strings.ToLower(text) {
			case "esnext":
				options.Module = core.ModuleKindESNext
				options.ModuleResolution = core.ModuleResolutionKindBundler
			case "commonjs":
				options.Module = core.ModuleKindCommonJS
				options.ModuleResolution = core.ModuleResolutionKindNode10
			default:
				return nil, optionError(name, fmt.Errorf("unsupported value %q", text))
			}
		default:
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported compiler option %q", name)
		}
	}
	if options.DeclarationMap.IsTrue() {
		options.Declaration = core.TSTrue
	}
	return options, nil
}

func tristate(value any) (core.Tristate, error) {
	parsed, ok := value.(bool)
	if !ok {
		return core.TSUnknown, fmt.Errorf("must be a boolean")
	}
	if parsed {
		return core.TSTrue, nil
	}
	return core.TSFalse, nil
}

func optionError(name string, err error) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("compiler option %q %w", name, err)
}

func virtualFileName(logical string) (string, error) {
	logical = strings.ReplaceAll(logical, "\\", "/")
	if strings.HasPrefix(logical, "/") || strings.Contains(logical, ":") {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("compiler input path %q must be relative", logical)
	}
	clean := path.Clean(logical)
	if clean == "." || clean == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(clean, "../") {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("compiler input path %q escapes the virtual project", logical)
	}
	return "/src/" + clean, nil
}

func emittedFileName(fileName string) string {
	fileName = strings.ReplaceAll(fileName, "\\", "/")
	return strings.TrimPrefix(fileName, "/out/")
}

func categoryName(category diagnostics.Category) string {
	switch category {
	case diagnostics.CategoryWarning:
		return "warning"
	case diagnostics.CategoryError:
		return "error"
	case diagnostics.CategorySuggestion:
		return "suggestion"
	case diagnostics.CategoryMessage:
		return "message"
	default:
		return "error"
	}
}

// lineIndex converts between byte offsets and (line, UTF-16 column) positions
// of one immutable text. Lines split on '\n'; a '\r' before it belongs to the
// preceding line's content.
type lineIndex struct {
	text   string
	starts []int
}

func newLineIndex(text string) *lineIndex {
	starts := []int{0}
	for offset := 0; offset < len(text); offset++ {
		if text[offset] == '\n' {
			starts = append(starts, offset+1)
		}
	}
	return &lineIndex{text: text, starts: starts}
}

func (index *lineIndex) lineCount() int { return len(index.starts) }

func (index *lineIndex) lineText(line int) string {
	if line < 0 || line >= len(index.starts) {
		return ""
	}
	start := index.starts[line]
	end := len(index.text)
	if line+1 < len(index.starts) {
		end = index.starts[line+1] - 1
	}
	return index.text[start:end]
}

func (index *lineIndex) utf16Length(line int) int {
	return utf16Extent(index.lineText(line))
}

func (index *lineIndex) position(byteOffset int) (line int, utf16Column int) {
	if byteOffset < 0 {
		byteOffset = 0
	}
	if byteOffset > len(index.text) {
		byteOffset = len(index.text)
	}
	low, high := 0, len(index.starts)-1
	for low < high {
		middle := (low + high + 1) / 2
		if index.starts[middle] <= byteOffset {
			low = middle
		} else {
			high = middle - 1
		}
	}
	return low, utf16Extent(index.text[index.starts[low]:byteOffset])
}

func (index *lineIndex) byteOffset(line int, utf16Column int) int {
	if line < 0 {
		return 0
	}
	if line >= len(index.starts) {
		return len(index.text)
	}
	lineText := index.lineText(line)
	consumed := 0
	for byteAt, character := range lineText {
		if consumed >= utf16Column {
			return index.starts[line] + byteAt
		}
		consumed += utf16RuneLen(character)
	}
	return index.starts[line] + len(lineText)
}

func utf16Extent(text string) int {
	length := 0
	for _, character := range text {
		length += utf16RuneLen(character)
	}
	return length
}

func utf16RuneLen(character rune) int {
	if character > 0xFFFF {
		return 2
	}
	return 1
}
